title: The Label Is Not the Origin
summary: An interactive investigation into how Switzerland produces, imports and transforms food, revealing the systems and territorial limits behind the label “Swiss made.”
description: An interactive investigation into how Switzerland produces, imports and transforms food, revealing the systems and territorial limits behind the label “Swiss made.”

pt: Uma investigação interativa sobre como a Suíça produz, importa e transforma alimentos, revelando os sistemas e os limites territoriais por trás do rótulo “Swiss made”.
